boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 獨立山古道（林業保育署國家步道官方頁，先民運物古道；日治阿里山鐵路以螺旋式環繞獨立山三週登頂，沿途溪谷、鐵道、隧道與吊橋景觀多變）步道主體（OSM footway 節點；海拔誠實留空）；與既有 tw-202 塘湖古道（2.01km）及 tw-105 太平雲梯／梅山36彎（2.74km）題材錯位——塘湖古道為石階古道主體、梅山36彎為公路髮夾彎主體，本點為鐵道螺旋環繞的國家步道主體。
boosters_i18n.en: Dulishan trail (officially listed as a national trail by the Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency; an old supply trail now spiralled three times by the Alishan Forest Railway around the lone-standing mountain, with creeks, rails, tunnels and a suspension bridge). Disjoint from tw-202 Tanghu stone-steps 2.01 km and tw-105 M36-bend highway viewpoint 2.74 km away (historic-steps and hairpin-highway subjects vs railway-spiral trail subject).
boosters_i18n.ja: 独立山古道（林業保育署公式、阿里山林鉄が三回り螺旋で登る国家步道）（OSM）。塘湖古道や梅山36彎とは題材が別。
